comment: Heading-anchor parity (audit D62): CJK, Devanagari, duplicates (GitHub's -1, -2), a `{…}` on a heading (an `^id` is no mark any more: it would be heading text), a [[link]], headings in a quote and a list, a setext heading, and heading-like lines in code, math and a hidden `key:: value` setext. headingAnchors, the renderer's h1–h6 ids (frontend MarkdownRenderer app/published, backend md2html) and the published TOC must agree on it. `{#custom}` ids are not a syntax Onden has: a trailing `{…}` is a block node's tags.
